1. Textfield that takes password as an input 
2. Password validation must be implemented based on below criteria 
 - Password should not contain any space.
 - Password should contain at least one digit(0-9).
 - Password must contain at least one lowercase letter (A-Z).
 - Password must contain at least one uppercase letter (A-Z).
 - Password must contain at least one character like this (@, #, %, &, !, $, etc…)
3. Create a function to check wheather the criteria meets or not
4. If any of the criteria not met then it must mention it below the password
